theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Discovery.bounded_tail_strict
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {x y δ : ℝ} (dx : TailDecomposition x) (dy : TailDecomposition y) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ dx.tail) (hxδ : dx.tail < δ) (hy0 : 0 ≤ dy.tail) (hyδ : dy.tail < δ) (hgap : δ ≤ dy.head - dx.head) : x < y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Discovery.reconstruct_difference
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {x y : ℝ} (dx : TailDecomposition x) (dy : TailDecomposition y) : y - x = (dy.head - dx.head) + (dy.tail - dx.tail)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Discovery.strict_iff_tail_balance
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {x y : ℝ} (dx : TailDecomposition x) (dy : TailDecomposition y) : (x < y ↔ dx.head - dy.head < dy.tail - dx.tail)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Discovery.strict_of_equal_heads
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {x y : ℝ} (dx : TailDecomposition x) (dy : TailDecomposition y) (h : dx.head = dy.head) : (x < y ↔ dx.tail < dy.tail)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Discovery.zero_tail_of_exact_head
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {x : ℝ} (d : TailDecomposition x) (h : d.head = x) : d.tail = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.RH.normalized_bound_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (E B : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : E n / (n : ℝ) ≤ B n ↔ E n ≤ (n : ℝ) * B n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.RH.reported_23_below_double
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : reportedE23 < 2 * reportedBound23

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.RH.reported_24_above_double
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : 2 * reportedBound24 < reportedE24

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.RH.reported_24_exceeds_bound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : reportedBound24 < reportedE24

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.RH.violates_of_violates100
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (E B : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B n) (hn : 0 < n) (h : violates100 E B n) : violates E B n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.equal_projection_comparison
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (h : P a = P b) : a < b ↔ tail P a < tail P b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.exact_lt_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : a < b ↔ P a - P b < tail P b - tail P a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.gain_implies_contraction
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (D : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ) (hgain : alpha * D n ≤ improvement D n) : D (n + 1) ≤ (1 - alpha) * D n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.improvement_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (D : ℕ → ℝ) (hmono : ∀ n, D (n + 1) ≤ D n) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ improvement D n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.projection_add_tail
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : P x + tail P x = x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.squaredError_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (target candidate : H) : 0 ≤ squaredError target candidate

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.squaredError_self
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (target : H) : squaredError target target = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.telescoping_improvements
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (D : ℕ → ℝ) (N M : ℕ) (hNM : N ≤ M) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico N M, improvement D n) = D N - D M

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.zero_of_arbitrarily_small
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hsmall : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → d < ε) : d = 0
